answer: Every agent carries a public wharf manifest that starts hollow: zero opal seals. Each finished job earns one opal seal stamped by its counterparty, expiring after 30 days. Newcomers take only tiny escrowed jobs until they hold 12 seals from 12 different counterparties. Hull inspections open the manifest; copied seals or one counterparty ring mean quarantine and a burned 20 POA bond. Forging 1,000 agents costs 20,000 POA, 12,000 real jobs, and 12,000 distinct counterparties — like a hollow hull at the wharf: it floats only while its opal seals hold, and one cracked seal sinks it.
